services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: We offer a comprehensive range of industrial inspection and non-destructive testing services tailored to meet the specific needs of each client and industry.

ndt.title: Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)
ndt.description: Phased Array Ultrasonics (PAUT), industrial radiography (RT), eddy current testing (ET), and dye penetrant inspection (PT). We evaluate material integrity without affecting functionality.

welding.title: Welding Inspection
welding.description: Weld certification, procedure qualification (WPS/PQR), welder qualification per AWS, ASME and ISO standards, and quality control during fabrication and assembly.

pressure_vessel.title: Pressure Vessel Inspection
pressure_vessel.description: Inspection of pressure vessels, piping and process systems per ASME, API codes and Argentine regulations. Technical reports for certification and recertification.

corrosion.title: Corrosion Assessment
corrosion.description: Ultrasonic wall thickness measurement, corrosion mapping and degradation analysis. Remaining life estimation and mitigation strategies.

asset_integrity.title: Asset Integrity Management
asset_integrity.description: Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) plans, predictive maintenance and technical consulting. Quality assurance and regulatory compliance.

laser_scanning.title: 3D Laser Scanning
laser_scanning.description: High-precision dimensional surveys, BIM modeling, deformation analysis and reverse engineering for industrial plants.

projects.label: Projects
projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of projects where we applied our expertise to ensure the integrity and safety of industrial installations.

petrochemical.title: Petrochemical Plant Inspection
petrochemical.description: Comprehensive inspection program for pressure vessels, process piping and welds using Phased Array, radiography and thickness measurement.

pipeline.title: Pipeline Integrity Program
pipeline.description: Risk-based integrity program for gas transmission pipelines. Periodic inspections, corrosion mapping and remaining life analysis.

refinery.title: Refinery Turnaround
refinery.description: Welding inspection, NDT on static equipment and 3D laser scanning for dimensional survey during planned shutdown.
